notes.title: What’s the purpose of collecting seashells?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39821017/7ec294a276dae3569708d2c836684e081167a340.png[/img]

Hey Islanders! We’re sure that you’ve come across these beautiful [b]seashells[/b] when you were cleaning the beach in the [b]Camping Builder[/b] demo, but did you take the time to collect all of them? If you thought that picking them up is a fruitless task then we have some news for you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39821017/c2decdae534b2a02825d1dfb7ba945d93747bd84.png[/img]

The [b]seashells[/b] that you find during your playthrough unlock some really cool stuff that you can place on your beach to make it even more attractive for tourists. These additional items are very eye-pleasing and will make for a great decoration around the bungalows and campfire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39821017/b653518467cfd9261fb2e72f5c055d1c66ad2007.png[/img]

[h3]Here is the list of unlockable items and the required seashell number to unlock them.[/h3]

[list]
[*] 5 – totem, torch
[*] 10 – hammock, beach chair, table
[*] 15 – bird’s nest
[*] 20 – beach umbrella, surfing boards
[/list]
If you didn’t feel motivated enough to gather all the [b]seashells[/b] before then we hope this short guide will make you jump right back into the demo and unlock all additional items to spruce up your magnificent beaches.

Till next time Islanders!

notes.title: The Volcano
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39821017/0d2680a0327613074fa91cb77dc731da483f826b.png[/img]

[b]Camping Builder[/b] is a simulation game like no other. Yes, you’re going to perform many actions like building, renovating, and decorating, but on top of it all, you will have environmental choices that will influence how the island reacts to your actions.

Let me give you an example. If you chop down a tree and use it as a building material, that’s perfectly fine. If you start going crazy slashing the trees one by one without planting new ones, you’re risking angering the island. From things like weather changes or animals running away to the eruption of the old volcano - the island has ways to express its wrath.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39821017/08cf6f2a8cd667390d4ff10fb75fbace42bb5ced.gif[/img]

But worry not, you will always have a way to redeem yourself, and your good actions will bring peace to the island once again. And remember, the [b]free Camping Builder demo[/b] will be out on the 21st of February!

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39821017/62eb6c94e14c5d0ce9f3c628290833addb7f9d0f.gif[/img]


The Camping Builder lets you play the way you like, and your decisions affect the environment around you. The patch you take is not final, and you can always change your mind about your actions, just like in real life. 

Are you going to segregate your trash and place it in the dedicated containers, or will you just dump the waste into the ocean? Will you be chopping down the trees and using the wood without a care, or will you be planting new ones to make up for it?

notes.title: You reap what you sow
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39821017/2b3df1cdbfee9256dd9fd6402268c3d189050a66.png[/img]

The island you’ve arrived on is not ready to accommodate camping guests. Take matters into your own hands and reuse materials you find around to transform them into something new. The first thing that comes to mind is the destroyed bungalows that you can transform into building material and then construct new guest houses out of them. There are plenty of good pieces of wood lying around that you can use for that purpose. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39821017/9fbc76c9acdd9191ce2cabf30f0c9d4064bd2bdb.gif[/img]

If that’s not enough, you can also chop down some trees to quickly turn them into wooden planks. Be careful not to go on a tree-chopping rampage because the trees are also an essential part of your camping site and the island’s ecosystem! Plant your seedlings and watch them grow into new trees. Keep the balance on the island, and you will have an excellent camping site in no time!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1545510/Camping_Builder/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38824567/015ad7d0f37b1b8fc23af0bb5277cd6391897d88.gif[/img]

notes.title: The island ecosystem - recycling
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39821017/cabac4370683f2ef09d1d68015e2a0031b363ebe.png[/img]
[b]
Camping Builder[/b] is a game where ecology and harmony with nature play a crucial role. Apart from the beautiful flowers and trees blooming all over the island, one of the first things you will notice while playing the game is the [b]colorful trash containers[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39821017/9b29676a6ad9c1fe4f0d0356175c9ad3888ddede.png[/img]

You guessed it right. They are there for [b]rubbish segregation[/b], and you, my friend, will use them to [b]recycle[/b]. Like in real life, different colors of the containers store various kinds of trash but worry not. The separation will be a relatively simple thing to do. With your trusty stick, you will be picking up the small leftovers that your fellow campers leave behind, putting those in a bin bag, and carrying them to the containers. The big ones you will take by hand.

But there is also a more accessible way to get rid of the trash in the [b]Camping Builder[/b]. You can simply [b]burn it or throw it into the ocean[/b] - done! If you choose this patch, though, the island will remember, and eventually, there will be repercussions… 


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1545510/Camping_Builder/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38824567/015ad7d0f37b1b8fc23af0bb5277cd6391897d88.gif[/img]

notes.title: A beautiful combination of simulation and nature preservation
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39821017/ed26c737c0ae61a588fac77402fef426291b8d4f.png[/img]

Our developers are working hard to bring you the first version of the Camping Builder. The game is already looking great, and we want to share the first screenshots with you guys. 

Camping Builder will be a simulation game unique in many ways. Apart from the building and renovation mechanics that you all know from our other games, the main plot will revolve around[b] nature preservation! 
[/b]
Yes, you heard it right. The beautiful island that the action will take place on is full of wildlife and rich flora. As the main character, you will be building and restoring a camping site that we would all love to spend time on, and while doing that, you will be making decisions that will affect the nature around you. 

Your choices will influence all living things around you, and we cannot wait to tell you more about this fantastic experience that the Camping Builder will be when it’s ready.

notes.title: Hotel Renovator's Wishlist Challenege!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36459112/e79899b00fe0d4a893f5909a3a271d7e33e65374.png[/img]

[b]Hotel Renovator's popularity is growing! That’s why we’re announcing the[u] Wishlist Community Challenge[/u]! [/b]

As you know, wishlists are super important for small indie developers like us. Thanks to you (because you pressed that small button on the store page which means a lot to us) we can constantly keep going and make awesome games. That’s why we want to thank you for your support and show you our gratitude! 

This should be easy because the only thing you have to do is to click that Wishlist button. If you already did that, just consider sharing our game with your friends! Each milestone will unlock one of the surprises we prepared for you, so the faster we get there, the sooner you will unlock special gifts for the whole community! It means the more people add the game to their wishlist, the more cool stuff we unlock.

From here we want to thank you all from the bottom of our hearts, especially people that are with us since the beginning - [b]YOU ROCK[/b]! :)

notes.title: Community Discord server - small changes and unification
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38824567/f6ee1f3169f30ef351db127f1fec98ee83317fa9.png[/img]
Hello there, faithful fans! 


We are making small changes to our Discord server that was made for our other game, Hotel Renovator.

Hotel Renovator is just one of our upcoming games focused on building and renovation. Recently we’ve launched a dedicated Discord Server for the Hotel but we’ve decided to change it a little bit and add all of our Builder/Renovator titles to the server and make it about them. 

So, since today on our Discord, you will find additional categories for games like:
Camping Builder: https://bit.ly/CampingBuilderSteam
Aquapark Renovator: https://bit.ly/AquaparkRenovator
Airport Renovator: https://bit.ly/AirportRenovator

more will be added in time

If you are interested in one of our games and you want to know everything about them first hand, join our community Discord today and don’t miss a thing! 

Remember, Discord is always the first place we share news, updates, and possible ideas that might be implemented in the game! If you want to be part of our community and help us make better games, feel free to join us anytime and share your ideas!
We are always open to your feedback!
